findings.evidence: `Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Measure/Map.lean:142`: `protected theorem map_smul {R} … (c : R) {μ} {f} (hf : AEMeasurable f μ)`; AcceptReject.lean:205 rewrites with it bare and line 210 is the dangling `exact`.
findings.fix: Supply the argument inline, `rw […, Measure.map_smul _ measurable_fst.aemeasurable, …]`, and lift the scalar step into a named `have hscalar : ((∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (min (f x) (c * g x)) ∂μ) / ENNReal.ofReal c)⁻¹ * (ENNReal.ofReal c)⁻¹ = (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (min (f x) (c * g x)) ∂μ)⁻¹` proved separately.
findings.issue: The six-lemma `rw` chain at 205-209 leaves a side goal from `Measure.map_smul` (its `hf : AEMeasurable f μ` is explicit and unsupplied), discharged out of sight at line 210 by `exact measurable_fst.aemeasurable`; a reader cannot tell which rewrite produced it. The tail `ENNReal.inv_div … div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm, ← mul_assoc, ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel …, one_mul` is pure scalar algebra buried in a measure rewrite.

findings.evidence: Lines 251-252 introduce `m`/`F`; lines 271 and 280 rewrite them back to their lambdas via `hm_def`/`hF_def`.
findings.fix: Drop the `with` unfolding round-trip (state the two `have`s about `min`/`ofReal` directly), and `set S := {x | 0 < f x ∧ f x ≤ c * g x} with hS_def` so the restricted integrals read uniformly.
findings.issue: In `acceptedLaw_ne_of_violation`, `set m … with hm_def` / `set F … with hF_def` are immediately undone by `simp only [hm_def, hF_def, …] at hx` (line 271) and `simp only [hF_def, …]` (line 280), so the abbreviation buys nothing where it is used; meanwhile the set `{x | 0 < f x ∧ f x ≤ c * g x}` is written out verbatim six times (254, 257, 262, 276, 278, 279).

findings.evidence: Lines 116-118 and 148-150 define `trialLaw_def`/`acceptedLaw_def` by `rfl`; line 170 instead unfolds `acceptSet` by name.
findings.fix: Add `theorem acceptSet_def (f g : α → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : acceptSet f g c = {p : α × ℝ | p.2 ≤ (fun x => f x / (c * g x)) p.1} := rfl` and rewrite with it, matching the idiom used for the other two definitions.
findings.issue: `rw [trialLaw_def, acceptSet, …]` unfolds `acceptSet` through its auto-generated equation lemma so the set-builder matches `{p | p.2 ≤ a p.1}` in `map_fst_restrict_prod_uniformMeasure`, while the sibling definitions get explicit `trialLaw_def` (116) and `acceptedLaw_def` (148) bridges.

summary: Proofs are mostly short, commented and use robust automation (fun_prop, positivity, nlinarith), but `acceptedLaw_eq` hides a mid-chain side goal and an opaque ENNReal scalar identity inside one rewrite chain, and two smaller readability issues remain.
